title: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage and planeswalker who put the young Loot under to use his mind as a map to the Meditation Realm and tries to seize its power to rewrite reality for Vraska.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon, former queen of the Golgari Swarm and Jace's lover, who traveled with him and Loot and appears in the realm trying to stop him.

entities.name: Loot
entities.description: A young creature whose mind contains the Multiverse as a map; Jace keeps him in a magical sleep to read it, and Narset comforts him.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: Waymaster of the Jeskai who reveals the true form of the Meditation Realm, helps stop Jace and rescues Loot.

entities.name: Elspeth
entities.description: An archangel and planeswalker who attacks Jace to stop him taking control of the realm.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: The elder spirit dragon who has made the Meditation Realm a prison for his brother Bolas, and who cannot help with the dragonstorms.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The elder dragon thought dead, alive but without his memories, chained in the Meditation Realm as Ugin's captive, who recognizes Jace as an accomplice.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker whom Vraska says Jace hurt badly when she was in his way.

entities.name: Ojutai
entities.description: The Jeskai dragonlord under whom Narset learned to let go of preconceptions.

entities.name: Meditation Realm
entities.description: A shifting realm that is a hub and substrate to all of reality and is Ugin's prison for Bolas; it reshapes itself to those who perceive it.

entities.name: Ugin's gem
entities.description: A gleaming jewel suspended between Ugin's horns whose power Jace steals to take control of the realm.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: The plane of dragons where Jace, Vraska and Loot lodged in Sultai territory.

entities.name: Avishkar
entities.description: A plane where Jace and Vraska did things to reach the Meditation Realm.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The invaders who broke the Multiverse and transformed Vraska.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: The guild Vraska once ruled as queen.

entities.name: Sultai
entities.description: The clan in whose territory Jace, Vraska and Loot stayed at an inn.

entities.name: Dragonstorms
entities.description: Storms that have spread from Tarkir to other planes.

entities.name: Omenpaths
entities.description: Portals through which Vraska and Loot travel without a spark.

events.summary: In a flashback, Vraska urges Jace to stop using Loot's mind, saying Loot keeps trying to hide from him.
events.quote: He keeps trying to hide from you.

events.summary: In the flashback, Jace admits he reaches into Loot's mind, Vraska compares it to what he did to Chandra, and they argue over whether the cost is worth it.
events.quote: You hurt her, Jace. You hurt her badly.

events.summary: Vraska begs Jace to let the dead rest, and Jace refuses, insisting he must fix everything.
events.quote: I know what I have to do.

events.summary: In a later flashback, Jace pursues Loot into a dragonstorm and puts him under with magic against his will.
events.quote: wrapping him in an unbroken blue light

events.summary: In the present, Jace says they are trapped in the Meditation Realm, and Narset tells her companions to empty their minds so the realm stops fighting.
events.quote: It's our thoughts that are trapping us in this shifting space.

events.summary: The realm reveals Ugin and a chained dragon together.
events.quote: revealing two figures that Narset would have known even in death

events.summary: Ugin warns them away, and Bolas, who has lost his memories, says he recognizes the three and calls Jace an accomplice.
events.quote: That you, perhaps, were an accomplice

events.summary: Ugin explains that he has made the realm a prison for his brother, to be kept until Bolas dies millennia from now.
events.quote: So, I have made this our prison

events.summary: Narset asks Ugin for help against the dragonstorms and he says he cannot.
events.quote: I am sorry, but there is nothing I can do.

events.summary: Bolas learns his name from Elspeth's argument and begins to remember.
Jace, who has already shifted to an illusory double, seizes the gem between Ugin's horns and an explosion of light follows.
events.quote: Jace closed his hands over the gleaming jewel suspended between Ugin's horns

events.summary: Jace reveals he wants to reverse Phyrexia's damage and control the realm; Elspeth attacks him and Narset protects her.
events.quote: What if I say that I can reverse everything?

events.summary: Narset rescues the terrified Loot as Elspeth fights Jace.
Jace explains the realm is a hub of reality that he can mold by will, to save Vraska from what Phyrexia did.
events.quote: This place is a substrate to all of reality, touching countless worlds and moldable by sheer force of will.

events.summary: Vraska appears, changed and grief-worn, and tells Jace to stop.
Jace, wielding the stolen power, shows glimpses of lost futures, but the strain breaks him and the realm begins to unmake itself.
events.quote: revealing a nothingness that ate at the eye

events.summary: Jace shatters like glass as emptiness rolls over him, and Elspeth tells Narset to run.
events.quote: As the emptiness rolled over him, he shattered like glass.

events.summary: Narset carries Loot as they flee.
events.quote: Narset, a wailing Loot in her arms, did as she was told.

relations.quote: You are not in a place to judge, my love,

relations.note: keeps Loot under magic to use his mind as a map
relations.quote: wrapping him in an unbroken blue light
So, I have made this our prison
You hurt her, Jace. You hurt her badly.
Gone the woman who'd once stood as queen of the Golgari Swarm.

relations.note: travels with Loot and Jace as an odd little family
